unanticipated_findings.summary: The Unimod lookup-result union (UnimodMatch / UnrecognizedUnimodName / UnrecognizedUnimodMass) is discriminated in three separate modules with no method on any member — the one finding in params/ that clears a cross-module bound.
unanticipated_findings.note: Verified: those are exactly the three isinstance(…, UnimodMatch) sites outside unimod_registry.py itself, in three different modules. This is the strongest thing either eval-1 run found and no assertion covers it. The proposed display_name(fallback) method with identity arms is a genuine remedy, not a token accessor.

unanticipated_findings.summary: The report also correctly excludes model.py:547 from that finding: that branch picks a search strategy (name lookup failed, try mass lookup) rather than a behaviour of the result, so no method should absorb it.
unanticipated_findings.note: The site exists as described. A precise negative call that keeps the remedy from over-reaching — worth crediting because it is the discipline the skill is supposed to install.

unanticipated_findings.summary: _add_variant_parameter_data fabricates LowerBoundedChargeRange(minimum=charge_range.minimum) — an instance of the OTHER member of the union it was handed — purely so the value type-checks against a helper it cannot otherwise reach.
unanticipated_findings.note: Verified verbatim in the source. This is the sharpest single piece of evidence in either eval-1 report: downcasting to the sibling variant to borrow a function is the missing method announcing itself. Only this run found it.
